question.problem:
Express the following arithmetic series using sigma notation.

$$
-12-7-2+3+8+…+28+33
$$
question.worked_solution:
The first term ${a}_{1}=-12$ and the common difference is:

$$
\begin{aligned}d & ={a}_{2}-{a}_{1} \\  & =-7-(-12) \\  & =5\end{aligned}
$$

Hence, the formula for the $n$th term is:

$$
\begin{aligned}{a}_{n} & ={a}_{1}+(n-1)d \\  & =-12+(n-1)(5) \\  & =-12+5n-5 \\  & =5n-17\end{aligned}
$$

We don't know the index of the last term, but we can find it using the formula for the $n$th term:

$$
\begin{aligned}{a}_{n} & =33 \\ 5n-17 & =33 \\ 5n & =33+17 \\ 5n & =50 \\ n & =10\end{aligned}
$$

There are $10$ terms in total, from $n=1$ to $n=10.$ So, the sigma notation for the given sum is:

$$
{\sum }_{n=1}^{10}(5n-17)
$$
